original_comparisons.note: Raw original JPEG against undistorted render; geometric warp differs. Metrics and pixel comparisons use the separate M10 reference sheets.

quality_verdict.verdict: Completed diagnostic pilot; recognizable foreground and consistent views, but background/reflective-surface defects remain. Not a successful quality improvement.
findings: Statue silhouette, gross pose and pedestal position agree across the six views; no large camera-convention reversal or whole-scene displacement.
Foliage, grass, facade windows and bench/background detail are blurred and locally smeared.
Black/green elongated floating splats and incomplete background coverage are visible near the upper edge in 000001; green streaks also cross sky in 000049.
Water, paving and the pedestal base lose detail and look melted; small plaques and local reflections are distorted.
Statue grey and pedestal green are broadly plausible; background color mixing and shadow/reflection differences remain.
quality_verdict.localization: M9 passes, M10 independent image/camera/pose/sparse checks pass, and PLY parameters match checkpoint with near-identical renders. No demonstrated export corruption or gross pose-convention bug; lower feature budget, different geometry and limited fitting are plausible contributors, not independently isolated causes. No parameter sweep or speculative numerical repair.
quality_verdict.comparison_limits: Whole-route comparison; M10 target dimensions/intrinsics differ slightly. Six views visually inspected; metrics aggregate all 33 held-out views. SfM used eval frames.
quality_verdict.gpu_mapper_scope: Caspar and Global GPU were separately validated through M8/M9 only, not trained/rendered in this follow-up.
